play_plan.meaning: An AI car is right behind you on track and closing in. The engineer warns that you are being chased.
play_plan.when_it_should_play: Race only (SessionType 7), green flag (RacePhase dword_7C56A8 == 5), player on track, a named AI car directly behind the player on the same lap.
play_plan.trigger: AI vehicle with lap distance veh+0x4044 slightly less than the player's on the same lap (or wrapped lap); gap within [G_min, G_max] (calibration); gap decreasing over N frames. Use lap distance, never race_position for ahead/behind (coordinator rule a).
play_plan.subject: AI driver id veh+0x489C of the chaser (queue a3 = chaser id, fills the driver-name slot)
play_plan.technique: own_emitter (ERE queues PWS eid 289 through InsertDriverTableEntry 0x418560 on controller 0x5EA618)
play_plan.latch_cooldown: once per chaser per 60 s; plus eid cooldown 1.0 s from dump
play_plan.must_not_play_when: player or chaser in pit (pittingStatus veh+0x3450 != 0); chaser lapped or more than one lap away; RacePhase != 5 (safety car, red flag); player retired; same chaser already announced in the latch window; MF line pending on eid 289 (DD-07; eid 289 has no hit in the MF census)
play_plan.conflicts: Not the team-order variant: no native team-order code exists (EVF TODO; findings.jsonl:565 note). Shares the chase state with any future overtake or position lines.
play_plan.calibration: G_min, G_max (gap in metres or seconds) and N frames: UNKNOWN, measure live
play_plan.live_test: 1) Start a race with AI, pitStatus 0, RacePhase 5. 2) Drive slowly on a lap until a faster AI car closes from behind. 3) Confirm the line is heard once per chaser. 4) Check the sim time advances between samples (identical samples mean pause).
play_plan.confidence: DERIVED (EVF EMITTER_SPECS.md:187 design; not in native code). Raise to CONFIRMED with an isolation test of the ERE emitter and its gate; FACT with a live hearing.
